show: Maid Marian and her Merry Men

eps.t: The Sharp End of a Cow

eps.d: Robin has made it to the top of the hero charts, with Rose his biggest fan.
Will Marian or Robin be executed first? And by Gary or Graeme?
This week, King John turns out to be a bit of a sweetie.
Rotten Rose tries to get free driving lessons.
It's not always easy having your mum to stay - especially when you're a dedicated freedom fighter.
Strange things are happening all over the East Midlands.
Robin serves up tall tales when it's his turn to cook supper.
It's a black day for Gary when redundancies are announced up at the castle.
While Robin and Barrington are busy playing Chronic the Hedgehog, Marian has been robbing the rich.
Fed up with doing all the work, Marian takes a job selling double glazing.
The Sheriff takes everyone to the seaside for a "High Forks Night" celebration.
Gladys's sleepy cake has some worrying side-effects.
Spooky goings-on force King John to reconsider his position as history's most unpopular monarch.

eps.t: Voyage to the Bottom of the Forest
eps.d: The medieval universe inhabited by Rabies is getting very strange indeed.
